text: Right now the storefront app runs exactly the way the Beginner project left it: installed directly on the Azure VM's OS, started by a systemd service. Terraform's cluster and the pipeline's deploy step both need an image to run before either one does anything, so containerizing comes first.
Stage one uses the full node colon 20.17.0-slim image, installs every dependency including dev dependencies with npm ci, and runs npm run build to produce a compiled dist folder.

Stage two starts a fresh runtime image, installs only production dependencies with npm ci --omit=dev, and copies in just the dist folder from the build stage. The compiler, the test runner, and the npm cache never exist in the shipped image.
A dot dockerignore file excludes node_modules, dot git, a stale local dist folder, and the dot env file, so none of them can poison the build or accidentally ship a secret.

Theo builds and runs the image locally, then curls the health endpoint for a clean 200 OK, before Terraform or the pipeline exist at all. Lesson 4 provisions the Azure infrastructure this image will actually run on.
